original_test_intent: Query FRU device 0 inventory-area metadata in-band and verify the returned area size and access mode, not merely transport completion.
original_method: Preserve raw Storage 0x0a/0x10 with request device ID 0x00; execute only after proving device 0 is the intended project FRU and through approved protected local access.
manual_activity: Project owner confirms once that FRU device 0 is present and intended and supplies its expected size/access constraints; the bounded read itself needs no per-run confirmation.
required_inputs: Get FRU Inventory Area Info response schema
Project expected range or inventory baseline
safety_requirements: Do not use plaintext sshpass credentials
Require host verification if remote orchestration is used
Reject nonzero completion or malformed length
Do not read or write FRU contents in this case
agent_execution_scope: Decode size and access mode with pinned schema
Return redacted metadata and non-mutation evidence
engineer_actions: Approve device-0 mapping and expected metadata policy
Review reserved access mode or impossible size

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The raw command matches Master, but the sshpass wrapper and disabled host checking violate credential/TLS-equivalent transport safety, and user interpretation is not an adequate automated oracle.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain `ipmitool raw 0x0a 0x10 0x00` on the verified DUT or an approved secure equivalent; validate completion, exact response length, little-endian area size and access mode.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Device ID 0, command bytes, attended time 10 and machine time 5 are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use protected in-band execution, machine-parse all area-info fields and compare device-0 size/access against the project inventory baseline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces unsafe orchestration and vague 'no error' acceptance only in the Review recommendation; Master source remains unchanged.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: This validates metadata for original device 0 only. Selecting a different FRU is a Project Override and leaves device-0 coverage unverified unless explicitly waived.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Incorrect size units or access-mode parsing can cause unsafe offsets in later FRU reads; inventory metadata can expose platform topology.

project_override_considerations: A vendor inventory API may be accepted only if it returns the same device-0 area size and access semantics. A high-level full FRU dump is broader and does not by itself prove raw 0x0a/0x10 behavior.
expected_evidence: Approved tool/interface and secure transport metadata
Decoded access mode including reserved handling
Proof no FRU content, logs or chassis state changed

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master criteria accepts any error-free command and generic setup clears logs, so it does not verify size/access correctness. DeepSeek adds unsafe credential and host-key handling. The Review layer retains the raw request but adds secure transport and deterministic parsing.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation, device byte and response purpose are explicit. Device identity and expected metadata are project readiness inputs; malformed or unsupported output can fail closed.

review_improvement: Makes device identity, field decoding and size/access acceptance machine-verifiable and removes unsafe remote-access advice without changing the original command.
independent_technical_reasoning: Area metadata is the safety boundary for subsequent FRU offsets and chunk sizes. An error-free response is not sufficient if the size is mis-decoded or the access mode is reserved. Because the request is bounded and read-only, exact schema validation supports full automation once device 0 is confirmed.
